name: omnata-plugin-development-skill
description: Guide for building plugins/connectors for the Omnata Sync Engine on Snowflake. Supports step-by-step and one-shot development modes, design decision prompts, and end-to-end sync iteration. Use when: creating a new Omnata plugin, building a plugin end to end, modifying an existing plugin procedure, debugging plugin behavior, deploying plugin changes, iterating on sync errors.
